title: math2 curriculum
description: A reading list in topics/curricula/. It has courses in teaching order, and each course has items in teaching order. Each item has a kind and at least one source. See spec 18.3 in tamnd/math2-agent.

curriculum.description: The name of the curriculum. It is the name of the file without .yaml.

sources.description: The sources that the items refer to. The key wikipedia is for the field wikipedia of an item, and each other key is a value of the field mathlib of an item.

texts.description: The books, notes, courses and papers that the curriculum names.
The books, notes, courses and papers that the course names.

decl.description: The Mathlib declaration that states or defines the item, if Mathlib has one.

wikipedia.description: The title of the English Wikipedia article about the item.

wikidata.description: The Wikidata item of the Wikipedia article.

mathlib.description: The Mathlib lists that give the item with the same decl.

node.description: The tag of the node for the item, when the node exists.

name.description: The name of the text for display.

resource.description: The resource id of the text in the catalogue of resources, or the id of an expression as ID/eN (change to K5.8 in tamnd/math2-agent). The field is not there until the resource is found.
